newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pro-Bhutto leader loses legal battle in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Pro-Bhutto leader loses legal battle in Pakistan.

text.p: The ex-chief minister of Sindh province, a member of Benazir Bhutto's Pakistan People's Party, on Thursday withdrew a legal challenge to the dissolution of the provincial assembly, a court official said.
He said lawyers for Abdullah Shah had withdrawn the petition before the Sindh High Court, meaning that he had accepted November's dissolution of the Sindh legislature.

The move followed Wednesday's endorsement by the Supreme Court of President Farooq Leghari's November 5 removal of Bhutto's government for alleged corruption and misrule. Leghari had also dissolved the National Assembly (lower house).
All of Pakistan's four provincial assemblies were dissolved after Leghari dissolved the National Assembly. Pakistanis go to the polls on Monday to elect new assemblies.
